blocks.html: Cloud native is the blueprint  to building web scale applications on the cloud that are more available and scalable.
blocks.text: Cloud native is the blueprint  to building web scale applications on the cloud that are more available and scalable.

blocks.html: It promises increased agility to ship new features quickly without compromising availability, making it quicker to respond to customer demands.

blocks.html: Simply running an app on cloud does not make it cloud native.

blocks.html: For an application to be cloud native, there are at least 4 pillars which must be considered.

blocks.html: Microservices based architecture must be used.
